title: Emails » View Contacts
text:
## Emails » View Contacts
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000048447
In this section the contacts that have been added to the site through various forms are stored:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145529535/original/djrcVYEWGNBuD1of3MEyUSJUcNE7e34tSA.png?1719523950 | alt: ]
Search and filter through these contacts by:
1. Name
2. Email Address
3. Form Submitted
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180358452/original/EDhSJl6yngLAnamKWaIc_LoiTPyq-oAZ_Q.png?1781313728 | alt: ]
Within " Actions " there is a set of actions:
1. Edit
2. Email
3. Delete
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180358454/original/CK-UyWI55ivyiFle04w3hycINlgEMajPzw.png?1781313758 | alt: ]
When editing there are 6 different sections to add or edit various information:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180358557/original/NSUqy6W9P1vT-p-f6T8kJ7P4OHLB3zFMdA.png?1781313991 | alt: ]
Click on Save Changes , to have all of the contact information saved properly in the system.

## Export Contacts
The Contacts can be exported by hovering over the Contact List Actions - Export Results:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12145529601/original/ZjAdi1v-w3_Gq-7qHP-YbEj8bDBoA3ytmg.png?1719523999 | alt: ]
Important note : this functionality is part of the Export Member Data addon: Export Member Data
